section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM - Instruments and Sender Gauges

content.description: Electrical schematic showing Oil Pressure Gauge connected to Ignition Switch and ground, with Test Bulb 3.4W connection point shown

subitems: (a) Disconnect the connector from the sender gauge. Ground the terminal through a 3.4W bulb as shown.
(b) Turn the ignition switch on. Check that the bulb starts flashing and the gauge pointer deflects.
If indications are not as specified, remove and test the receiver gauge.
(a) Disconnect the connector from the sender gauge.

(b) Connect a 12V battery to the sender gauge terminal in series with a 3.4W bulb. Check that the bulb does not light when the engine is stopped, and flashes when the engine is running. The number of flashes should vary with engine speed.
If operation is not as specified, replace the sender gauge.

content.description: Test setup showing Test Bulb 3.4W connected between Battery and sender gauge connector for testing
Electrical schematic showing Brake Warning Light connected to Battery and brake fluid level warning switch with body ground

subitems: (a) Disconnect the connector from the brake fluid level warning switch. Connect the switch terminal 1 and body ground.
(b) Turn the ignition switch on. Check that the bulb lights.
If operation is not correct, remove and test the bulb.

items.main: INSPECT OPERATION OF BRAKE FLUID LEVEL WARNING SWITCH
subitems: Inspect the switch operation when the switch is OFF (float up) and when the switch is ON (float down).
If operation is not as specified, replace the switch.

content.description: Illustration showing brake fluid level warning switch mounted on brake master cylinder

items.main: INSPECT OPERATION OF PARKING BRAKE SWITCH
subitems: Using an ohmmeter, inspect the continuity between the terminals 1 and 2.
(a) Check that there is continuity when the switch is free (parking brake lever up).
(b) Check that there is no continuity when the switch pin is pushed (parking brake lever down).
If operation is not as specified, replace the switch.
